claims.text: All four fixed plan indices have at most one native attempt; censored, failed, unsupported and interrupted cells remain in the denominator.
A constructed prime curve is labelled as the requested n61 case only after its public artifact records p=2^61-1 and native verification passes.
Root and enumerate artifacts are retained at their actual bounded native verification scope; neither a timeout nor a partial domain is promoted to a negative PDP result.
An ECDLP solve is labelled only if a scalar was independently recovered without the construction witness and replayed on the declared generator and target.
Each terminal shard retains its stage receipts and restricted archive with S3 PUT and fresh GET/hash, or its exact failed custody stage.
No method speed ranking, exhaustive n61 search, general PDP negative, complete root execution cost, instruction count, exact fall degree, or broader curve-matrix conclusion is inferred.
